note: Source of truth for decisions. YET = waiting on Jay; DONE = decided (outcome recorded). The hub's Decisions tab and decisions.md are generated from this file.

items.title: Apply the server-checked fights migration
items.body: The fight_sessions migration (single-use seed, transcript, server replay) is written and the client is ready. Nothing changes until it is applied.

items.title: Sound direction and sourcing
items.body: Overall feel for the cue sheet (sfx-cue-sheet.md), and whether to use CC0 packs or your own recordings. Real samples will beat more synthesis; I can't download them from here.

items.title: Play Maps 1–4 and say how difficulty and rewards feel
items.body: Map 1 is an on-ramp; Maps 1–2 have reward cards; Map 2 retuned. Note: since 2026-10-08 Conquest fights default to Open mode (no collapsing), which changes how the AI and positions play, so the old difficulty numbers need a re-check.
items.default: I re-simulate win rates under Open mode next

items.title: Which beasts the Hummingbirds befriend; proposed card renames
items.body: Open questions from lore-bible.md. Dogs and cats are settled (see L2).

items.title: Native-speaker review for Tagalog, Tamil, Japanese and Korean
items.body: Machine-quality translations ship now (including card names). A native pass would catch tone and idiom.

items.title: Translate text that contains numbers
items.body: Lines like "3 cards", "Pack 2 of 10", "N new cards!" stay English because the translator matches whole strings. Fix: number-aware templates for each language.

items.title: Hero levelling pace, stat prices, and Materia socketing (v2)
items.body: Play a few fights with a Hero and say how it feels; do you want Materia socketing next?

items.title: The 3-part Hero XP bar (feedback item 17)
items.body: How the three XP bars should split (battle XP, Materia XP, ...?) — needs your picture of it.

items.title: A free pack for guests before sign-in
items.body: Let a guest open one Sprout Pouch before asking them to sign in.

items.title: Disenchant values (Magic Dust per extra copy)
items.body: Built with: Common 5, Uncommon 8, Rare 15, Very Rare 20, Super Rare 30, Epic 40, Heroic 50, Unique 60, Legendary 100, Mythic 150, Ancient 200. Never Base/Quest/levelled/foil/Shiny; keeps one copy.

items.title: Shiny look
items.outcome: Hue shift, not a foil: the art is recoloured by a fixed per-card hue (90–270°), soft white glow, twinkling ✦. Prism stays a foil treatment.

items.title: Which cards get the six new finishes
items.body: Hex, Etched, Ice, Gold leaf, Reverse and Prism are built (Effects Lab → Card treatment centre). Who gets them: rarities, events, pack tiers, prestige?

items.title: Combo counter
items.body: A counter for chains of triggered abilities in one round, with escalating sound/visuals.

items.title: Siding with Otters or Hummingbirds (proposal)
items.body: See siding-proposal-2026-10-08.md: a standing meter moved by dialogue choices and which side's fights you take, unlocking side-specific rewards, titles and a late-game fork.

items.title: Catch-up mechanics
items.body: Rested XP, a weekly comeback quest tier, cheaper early Conquest once you've cleared further, a gentler curve.

items.title: Replays
items.body: Watch-only or re-fight this deck? Share links? How many to keep?

items.title: The Nest repeats the Codex
items.body: You noted the Nest overlaps the Codex. Kept for now. Ideas when you're ready: the Nest as your trophy shelf (Shinies, foils, prestige), or merge it into Codex as an Owned filter.

items.title: Skirmish default mode
items.outcome: All Conquest skirmishes default to Open (no collapsing). Gravity (collapsing) is special, set per skirmish. Built.

items.title: Frozen field effect
items.outcome: Tundra fights: Field card by the enemy deck, snowfall, one card per side +1 Wait each turn with an ice pulse. Built.

items.title: Dogs and cats
items.outcome: Neutral creatures, not pets: friends of both peoples. War dogs carry weapons in their mouths and stay four-legged. Recorded in lore-bible.md.

items.title: Translate card names
items.outcome: Yes: card names are translated in all 12 languages.

items.title: Disenchanting rules
items.outcome: Base and Quest cards can't be disenchanted (Base cards level up through play, 1–10). Levelled cards and cards with a skin are never disenchanted. A quick Disenchant extras button keeps one of each.

items.title: Shiny chance
items.outcome: 0.5% for every card received, Base and Quest included.

items.title: Unfinished fights
items.outcome: No Resume/Discard pop-up; Home's Play tile turns into a green Continue with the fight as its subtitle.

items.title: Tutorial hands over the starter deck
items.outcome: After the last tutorial win the player presses Add to deck and watches the cards go in.

items.title: PixelLab credits
items.outcome: Wait for the monthly reset, then finish Maps 8–10 and the Home sprites. No purchases.

items.title: Currencies and Materia
items.outcome: Many currencies are fine as long as each shows only where it matters.

items.title: Farms and potions
items.outcome: Approved as sketched: real-time plots, PvE-only potions, sellable once trades are server-side.

items.title: Sound sourcing plan
items.outcome: CC0 first (Kenney, OpenGameArt, Freesound) plus our own jsfxr, with audio/ and CREDITS.md.

items.title: Effects picks
items.outcome: Holo foil, depth parallax, battlefield weather.

items.title: Alt-art

items.title: Apply the admin player list function
items.body: The Admin → Players portal reads one admin-only, read-only database function (admin_list_players: profiles, levels, currencies, cards, matches; no emails). Written in supabase/proposed/20261008_admin_list_players.sql. Applying it (and the panel that reads it, already drafted) was held for your OK.

items.title: Anti-cheat tier 1
items.body: Players can currently edit their own rating and currencies from the browser console. Tier 1 makes rating read-only and refuses any single write that adds more than 2,000 Maple / 200 Gold Leaves. supabase/proposed/20261008_anticheat_tier1.sql.

items.title: Turn on leaked-password protection
items.body: Supabase dashboard → Auth → Passwords → leaked password protection. Free, one click, needs your login.

items.title: SonarCloud as well as CodeQL?
items.body: CodeQL now scans every push (free, GitHub → Security). SonarCloud adds code-quality and duplication reports; it needs you to sign in at sonarcloud.io and add a token.

items.title: Pack contents and foil odds
items.outcome: Pack editor (Admin): per pack price, size, pool, rarity weights, foil chance per card, guaranteed foil, and finish weights (By rarity 60, Prism 9, Hex 8, Etched 7, Ice 7, Reverse 6, Gold 3). Sprout Pouch 4% foil per card, Acorn Chest 8%, Golden Bramble Case 12% with one guaranteed. A card's From picks its pack pool. Publishes live as __cfg:shop-packs.

items.title: Over-size decks and the main deck
items.outcome: Decks can hold any number of cards while building (calm 'N over' note, no red shake). ★ Main deck is chosen explicitly and is what you play with; only a 20-card main deck can be played.

items.title: API keys + monthly caps for GPT Image and fal/Kling
items.body: Create the keys yourself, keep them as local environment variables (never in the repo), set a monthly cap in each dashboard. Nothing is bought without your OK. See asset-pipeline-action-items.md.

items.title: Train a Bramblewood pixel LoRA?
items.body: FLUX.2 [dev] trained on ~30 of our PixelLab cards (~$6.40 per 1,000 steps on fal), for Maps 9–10 cards and Home sprites while PixelLab is capped.

items.title: 30 s trailer from Kling clips
items.body: 5–6 Kling 3.0 image-to-video clips (splash crowd, pack tear, Shiny reveal, Ember Chipmunk fire, castle fall) cut with gameplay capture.

items.title: Upgrade / Refine / Enchant
items.outcome: Forge has three tabs. Upgrade = level 1–10 then Prestige. Refine = your best copy up the finish ladder Plain → Foil → Hex → Etched → Cracked ice → Reverse → Prism → Gold leaf (costs rise; Prism/Gold need Gold Leaves); never makes Shiny. Enchant = socket one Materia (Ember +1⚔ and scorching hits, Stone +3❤, Tide +2❤, Grove +1⚔+1❤); crystals are the player's now, crafted from Dust without a Hero.

items.title: Shiny in battle
items.outcome: Shiny is rolled in the one grant function, so any card received can be Shiny. A card you own a Shiny copy of is Shiny in your hand and on the board, and units it spawns are Shiny too.

items.title: Enchant and Refine numbers
items.body: Enchant: Ember +1⚔ (scorch), Stone +3❤, Tide +2❤, Grove +1⚔+1❤. Refine costs from 40✨+100🍁 (Foil) up to 200✨+450🍁+10🍂 (Gold leaf). Tide is currently a weaker Stone; give it something of its own?

items.title: Open-mode difficulty tweaks
items.body: Re-simulated under Open fights (difficulty-open-mode-2026-10-08.md): Maps 1–4 got easier; Map 3's first two skirmishes (16 HP) are now easier than Map 2's; the Frost Yeti King (130 HP) is a 0% wall. Proposed: Badger Warband and Quill Line to ~22 HP; Yeti King to ~90 HP or make its fight Gravity (collapsing) as a special.

items.title: Skirmish balance audit proposals
items.body: skirmish-balance-audit-2026-10-08.md proposes HP changes on 72 nodes and 33 deck swaps to smooth the zig-zag difficulty curve (15 walls, 19 trivial fights). Thistle Fields, Pebble Beach and the Grotto were tuned separately on 2026-10-09.
options: Apply walls and trivial fights only
items.default: Apply walls and trivial fights only

items.title: Enemy deck level reads 0 on most nodes
items.body: Most enemy cards have no rarity set (171 of 355 cards), so the skirmish panel's Enemy deck Lv counts them as Base and shows 0. Option: infer a weight from each card's power (attack, health, skills, cost) when it has no rarity.
options: Set rarities on all cards (a content pass)

items.title: Lock the battle type in the skirmish editor?
items.body: You said 'You CANNOT change the battle type once it's been set in the skirmish editor'. In a local test the change saved fine. Is that a bug you hit (it reverted?), or a request to lock the field after the first save?

items.title: Victory shift and the castle's white gradient
items.body: Couldn't reproduce either. Which cards move at the end of a fight, and when? Where does the white gradient on the castle show (fight, map, results)? A screenshot would settle both.

items.title: What do Krooni 👑 buy?
items.body: The Golden case gives 3 Krooni. Nothing spends them yet, and they're kept on this device only (no database column). Ideas: cosmetic finishes, a Krooni-only pack, or Hero rarity boosts.

items.title: Promotion cost and level
items.body: Worker Ant promotes at Lv 3 for 60 Maple Leaves + 20 Dust. The ant goes back to Lv 0, so it can be promoted again into the other choices. Ant Warrior uses the Soldier Ant's art for now.

items.title: Nurse master bonus
items.body: The Nest Nurse (a Unique+ card or the Wandering Traveller) is in, but what it does is still open. Ideas: eggs hatch 25% faster; a small chance a hatch comes out Shiny.

items.title: Archetypes: which to build first
items.body: archetypes-design-2026-10-09.md has 10 archetypes plus the Elder / Outer / Forgotten trio. Suggested order: an active Exile zone, Swarm, Tide, Devilry circles, Elder Ones, then Evolution ride. Each archetype lists its open questions.

items.title: New Unique cards can break the raid ghost generator
items.body: Making the Wandering Traveller Unique left stage-5 ghost decks under 20 cards, so it was reverted. The generator needs a fallback before more Unique cards are added.
